BETA Close X Associated British Foods PLC announced on April 23, 2026, that it repurchased 200,000 of its ordinary shares for cancellation at an average price of GBp 1834.4530 per share, with the highest price paid being GBp 1849.0000 and the lowest at GBp 1825.5000. These transactions were conducted on the exchange from Barclays Capital Securities Limited as part of the company's share repurchase program initiated on February 25, 2026. Disclaimer* Associated British Foods PLC 23 April 2026 23 April 2026 Associated British Foods plc Transaction in own shares Associated British Foods plc (the " Company ") announces that on 23 April 2026 it purchased for cancellation from Barclays Capital Securities Limited (" Barclays ") the following number of its ordinary shares of 5 15/22 pence each pursuant to the authority granted by its shareholders as part of its share repurchase programme, details of which were announced on 25 February 2026. Description of shares: Associated British Foods plc Ordinary shares of 5 15/22 pence Date of transaction: 23 April 2026 Number of shares repurchased: 200,000 Average price paid per share: GBp 1834.4530 Highest price paid per share: GBp 1849.0000 Lowest price paid per share: GBp 1825.5000 The Company intends to cancel these Shares. All shares were purchased from Barclays as an on exchange transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. The table below contains detailed information of the individual trades made by Barclays as part of the buyback programme.
